nodes.description: Implement the approved Story, demonstrate RED/GREEN and simplify while green.
nodes.verify: Run related checks and record the changed files and evidence.

nodes.description: Review the final diff against the Story, including failure paths.
nodes.verify: Record findings and evidence; fail with the corrective action if changes are needed.

nodes.description: Run fresh verification after review fixes; prepare raw evidence for G4.
nodes.verify: Record actual commands, exit codes, changed-file scope and unproven boundaries.

output.summary: Team Story board stage 1 (hub) implemented on codex/team-story-hub (PR #29): src/hub/story-protocol.ts (pure limits, branch names, graph validation: cycles, out-of-project repo, unordered same-repo file overlap, append rules), src/hub/story-store.ts StoryBoard (projects, publish draft->open, add tasks, cancel, claim with one open task per member and link-repo scope, refetch, heartbeat-derived held, PL/admin release and cancel, rerun with memo, per-(story,repo) merge lock with self-unlock, idempotent merged/failed reports, late merged report from the last lock holder after a PL release, story verify and complete), /api/link/story/* routes on protocol 3 with protocols 1/2 unchanged. TDD per task (subagent-driven, 5 tasks), then one final fix wave (F1-F10) and the N1 lock-holder fix (d595316), each test RED before GREEN. root 765/765, typecheck 0, Story checker 0.

Reviewed against the Story (M16/V18/D24) and the G3 decision, including failure paths: 5 task reviews (spec + quality) all Approved with no Critical/Important; whole-branch review (opus) 'With fixes' with I1 refetch, I2 self-unlock, I3 terminal own claim vs NOT_YOURS and verify resend, I4 late merged report after PL release, I5 recovery without the PL, plus 10 minors triaged; one fix wave addressed F1-F10 under a scoped re-review, which found N1 (late path accepted a claim that gave up its own lock); N1 fixed in d595316 and re-reviewed as addressed with no new breakage. Deferred items are assigned to the stage 2/4/5 plans (story-table migration helper, base branch before add-tasks, 1 MiB request limit, list-view data).

Fresh verification 2026-10-22 after the last review fix, on d595316 (bcb76df adds only docs/STATUS.md): npm test 765/765 (baseline 721 + 44 new), npm run typecheck exit 0, Story checker exit 0; working tree clean and equal to origin/codex/team-story-hub. Baseline note: 692/721 before npm run build:office in the new worktree (29 'Build the Office UI before starting.'), 721/721 after. Unproven: Offices calling the story routes (stages 2-5), a Fusion redeploy (schema added to the existing PVC SQLite, existing Office links kept), multiple PCs, company IT policy, real GitHub Enterprise branches/PRs.
